mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p >0.05) during monetary easing periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden inflation spike (CPIAUCSL crossing above 215) triggers investor concerns about rising rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 215, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates (monetary tightening) combined with declining GDP demand create conflicting signals, generating uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above previous level and GDPC1 crosses below previous level
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not negative when both proxies move in specified directions, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion phase, high demand (GDPC1) and high supply (INDPRO) signals peak growth, leading to S&P 500 declines over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not negative during late-cycle expansion periods, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Continuously rising GDP demand signals strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) despite rising GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden jump in employment (PAYEMS) above 134,000 signals a robust labor market, boosting investor confidence and S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not positive when PAYEMS crosses above threshold, or p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneously high federal funds rates (monetary tightening) and strong demand (HOUST) create conflicting signals, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 1.5% and HOUST crosses above 583
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not negative when both proxies meet trigger, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE <7%) combined with high federal funds rates (monetary tightening) signals tight labor markets and inflation risks, leading to S&P 500 declines over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not negative when both conditions met, or p-value >0.05 in t-test.
